ConnectionStrings._comment: Local development only — not a secret, not used against any real environment. Real environments supply this via Key Vault / managed identity (CLAUDE.md Section 4.7), never a committed appsettings value.

Stripe._comment: Local development only — not real keys, not a secret. Deliberately not shaped like sk_/whsec_ (a real Stripe key/secret prefix) even as an obvious placeholder — gitleaks' stripe-access-token rule matches on shape alone, not on whether the value is real, and rightly doesn't try to guess intent. Real environments supply these via Key Vault / managed identity (CLAUDE.md Section 4.7).

Editor._comment: The editor SPA's dev-server origin (same placeholder OpenIddictSeeding.cs already uses for the OAuth redirect URI) — where Stripe Checkout/Portal send the user back to.
